summary: SciSparc Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 23, 2026, announcing that its subsidiary NeuroThera Labs Inc. (TSXV: NTLX) expanded its U.S. patent portfolio via its collaboration with Clearmind Medicine Inc. (Nasdaq: CMND). Three U.S. patent applications were published covering combinations of LSD, ketamine and ibogaine with N-acylethanolamines, including NeuroThera's proprietary palmitoylethanolamide (PEA), for mental health, pain and substance use indications. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated. This is a routine product/IP update disclosing no special-situation event; no deal terms, mechanics or risk-arb angle apply.
